findings.title: Contingently-issuable treatment of warrant shares is paraphrased without citing its quote
findings.detail: In the Model and valuation section, note.md says 'The 10-Q treats the warrant shares as contingently issuable and excludes them from diluted EPS until they vest'. This is a sourced statement, and it is accurate: periodic.txt line ~1425 Note 14 / the EPS policy, captured verbatim as Q-17 in narrative.json. But the note gives no [[Q-17]] marker, so a reader cannot trace it the way the neighbouring claims (Q-12, Q-13, Q-15, Q-16) can be traced. The paraphrase also shortens 'until all the conditions for the warrants to become vested and exercisable have been satisfied' to 'until they vest'. That does not change the meaning in a material way.
evidence: generator/note.md (Model and valuation, customer warrants bullet)
findings.required_evidence: note.md cites [[Q-17]] where it states the contingently issuable / EPS-exclusion treatment
